title: Apontar para baixo
description: Personagem realiza um CTA natural apontando duas vezes para a região inferior da tela.
prompt:
The character maintains the exact identity, face, hairstyle, clothing and environment from the reference image.

Keep the smartphone hand stable.

Using only the free hand, naturally raise the index finger and point toward the lower area of the frame.

Perform two clear downward pointing gestures.

The hand must remain around waist-to-chest distance from the body and must NOT move close to the camera lens.

Movement is smooth, controlled and natural.

Maintain relaxed posture and a subtle confident expression.

Static mirror-selfie framing.

No camera zoom.
No camera shake.
No hand covering the lens.
No waving.
No clothing changes.
No facial identity changes.
No extra fingers.
No distorted hands.
No speech.
No lip sync.
usageTip: Use como call-to-action no final de Reels e TikToks. Combine com texto na parte inferior da tela indicando o link ou próximo passo.
avoidList: Aproximar a mão demais da lente
Fazer mais de dois gestos de apontar
Adicionar zoom ou movimento de câmera
Mudar expressão facial de forma exagerada

title: Mostrar look + giro lateral
description: Movimento natural de selfie em que a personagem alisa a roupa e gira suavemente para mostrar o look.
prompt:
Preserve the exact person, face, hairstyle, body proportions, outfit, smartphone and environment from the reference image.

The smartphone hand remains stable throughout the shot.

With the free hand, gently smooth the outfit from the waist toward the hip in one natural movement.

Immediately afterward, rotate the torso and hips approximately 25 to 30 degrees to one side to show the outfit from a slightly different angle.

Finish in a relaxed side pose.

Keep the movement subtle, feminine, continuous and realistic.

Maintain natural fabric physics.

No camera zoom.
No sudden body movement.
No outfit transformation.
No facial changes.
No distorted anatomy.
No extra fingers.
No speech.
No lip sync.
No audio required.
usageTip: Ideal para apresentar looks completos em posts de moda. O giro sutil destaca a roupa de múltiplos ângulos sem parecer forçado.

title: Mão na lente
description: A mão livre se aproxima até cobrir completamente a câmera, criando uma transição natural.
prompt:
Preserve the exact character, face, outfit, smartphone and environment from the reference image.

The hand holding the smartphone remains stable.

The free hand opens naturally with the palm facing the camera.

Move the open palm smoothly toward the lens in one continuous controlled movement.

The palm progressively fills the frame until it completely covers the camera.

End with the entire frame naturally obscured by the palm.

Do not wave.
Do not point.
Do not create a peace sign.
Do not change the outfit.
Do not change facial identity.
No camera zoom.
No sudden acceleration.
No extra fingers.
No distorted hand anatomy.
No speech.
No lip sync.
usageTip: Perfeito como transição entre cenas em Reels e TikToks. O corte acontece quando a mão cobre totalmente a lente, revelando o próximo conteúdo.
avoidList: Mover muito rápido ou dar solavancos
Mudar de roupa durante a transição

title: Aproximar e posar
description: Personagem se aproxima suavemente e termina em uma pose natural.
prompt:
Preserve the character and environment from the reference image.

The subject takes one small natural step toward the camera while maintaining relaxed posture.

After the step, subtly shift body weight to one side and settle into a confident natural pose.

Keep shoulders relaxed and body movement fluid.

Maintain exact facial identity, clothing and proportions.

No running.
No lunging.
No exaggerated hip movement.
No camera zoom.
No body deformation.
No clothing transformation.
No speech.
No lip sync.
usageTip: Use para criar uma sensação de proximidade e confiança. Funciona bem em aberturas de vídeo e apresentações de produto.

title: Push-in suave
description: A câmera se aproxima lentamente do assunto sem utilizar zoom digital.
prompt:
Preserve the subject, product and environment exactly as shown in the reference.

Create a slow physical camera push-in toward the main subject.

The camera moves smoothly forward through space while maintaining the same focal perspective.

The subject remains mostly still.

Maintain realistic parallax between foreground and background.

No digital zoom.
No sudden acceleration.
No camera shake.
No subject deformation.
No environment transformation.
No added objects.
usageTip: Cria profundidade e foco sem distorção de zoom. Ideal para dar destaque a um produto ou personagem central.
avoidList: Usar zoom digital em vez de movimento físico
Deformar o assunto durante a aproximação

title: Órbita lateral suave
description: Movimento lateral discreto da câmera revelando profundidade e perspectiva.
prompt:
Maintain the exact subject and environment from the reference image.

Move the camera slowly in a subtle lateral arc around the subject.

Create realistic perspective change and natural parallax.

The subject remains visually consistent and mostly stationary.

Movement must be smooth, slow and controlled.

No digital zoom.
No sudden orbit.
No environment morphing.
No subject deformation.
No duplicated objects.
No cinematic exaggeration.
usageTip: Revela profundidade e dimensão do ambiente. Excelente para apresentar produtos em contextos espaciais.

title: Limpeza satisfatória de rejunte
description: Escova remove progressivamente a sujeira do rejunte e revela o resultado da limpeza.
prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic vertical 9:16 UGC product demonstration video based on the provided reference image.

Preserve the original cleaning product, environment, surface, lighting and camera perspective.

Start with a small section of tile grout containing visible but realistic dirt.

A realistic human hand places the cleaning brush directly against the dirty grout.

Scrub using several short controlled back-and-forth movements.

The bristles physically interact with and compress against the surface.

As the brush repeatedly passes over the area, the dirt gradually decreases.

Cleaning must happen progressively and only where physical contact occurs.

Do not make dirt disappear instantly.

After cleaning, move the brush slightly away and reveal the cleaner grout.

Close-up smartphone UGC framing.

Mostly stable camera with subtle natural handheld micro-movement.

Natural hand anatomy.
Realistic brush pressure.
Realistic bristle movement.
Natural shadows.

No speech.
No music.
No text.
No added logos.
No extra hands.
No duplicated fingers.
No warped product.
No floating objects.
No magical instant cleaning.
No robotic movement.
usageTip: Conteúdo UGC satisfatório de alta performance. A progressão da limpeza mantém o espectador até o resultado final.
avoidList: Adicionar mãos extras ou dedos duplicados

title: Pano absorvendo líquido
description: Pano passa pelo líquido derramado, absorvendo progressivamente e revelando a superfície limpa.
prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic vertical 9:16 UGC product demonstration video using the provided reference image.

Preserve the cloth, surface, hand appearance, lighting and environment.

Start with a realistic amount of liquid visibly spilled across the surface.

A realistic hand places the absorbent cloth against one edge of the spill.

Apply gentle pressure and move the cloth slowly through the liquid in one continuous cleaning movement.

The liquid progressively disappears ONLY where the cloth physically passes.

The liquid edge visibly retreats while being absorbed.

Show realistic cloth compression, folds and interaction with the wet surface.

After the pass, reveal the cleaned area.

The cleaned region must correspond directly to the path of the cloth.

Realistic absorption physics.
Natural hand anatomy.
Natural wrist movement.
Realistic fabric texture.
Natural shadows and reflections.

No speech.
No music.
No text.
No added logos.
No extra hands.
No distorted fingers.
No floating objects.
No magical instant absorption.
No robotic movement.
usageTip: Demonstração UGC que mostra absorção em tempo real. O efeito antes-e-depois acontece no mesmo take, sem cortes.

title: Organizador de geladeira
description: Transformação visual mostrando alimentos sendo organizados progressivamente em recipientes transparentes.
prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic vertical 9:16 UGC organization video using the provided reference image.

The scene takes place inside an open refrigerator.

Preserve the refrigerator structure, shelves, lighting, food items and organizer design from the reference.

Start with food items naturally positioned in a slightly disorganized arrangement.

Realistic human hands organize the visible items using transparent refrigerator organizers.

Pick up one item at a time and physically move it into the appropriate organizer.

Objects must physically travel from their original position to their new position.

Do not teleport objects.
Do not make objects disappear.
Do not spontaneously generate new food.

Maintain realistic scale and perspective.

Finish with the refrigerator visibly organized, with food naturally grouped inside the organizers.

Hold the final composition briefly.

Smartphone UGC perspective facing the refrigerator.

Natural hand anatomy.
Realistic object weight and grip.
Realistic transparent plastic.
Natural refrigerator lighting.

No speech.
No music.
No text.
No duplicated objects.
No floating objects.
No teleportation.
No warped organizers.
No distorted fingers.
usageTip: Conteúdo de organização satisfatório muito popular em Reels. A transformação gradual mantém o espectador engajado.
avoidList: Teletransportar objetos de uma posição para outra
